blocks.text: CLEANOUT FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Commercial Junk Removal in Aurora, ON

items.q: How is the price calculated for commercial junk removal in Aurora?
a: We offer complete cleanout services for homes, condos, apartments, garages, basements, attics, storage units, offices, rental properties, estates, and commercial spaces. Whether you’re moving, downsizing, renovating, or clearing out a property, our team can help.

items.q: Why not just rent a dumpster?
a: The same geography that built Schomberg — the crossroads. Our trucks already run the 9, the 27 and the 400 corridor daily, so staging a crew here costs nothing extra, which is why full-property cleanouts that other companies price high for small villages book normally with us.

items.q: Can you work outside our business hours?
a: That’s exactly what our sort is built to catch, especially in a village that knows the value of old things. Anything that looks like it might be worth more than a donation gets flagged and set aside for the family to assess or consign before it’s sorted anywhere else.

items.q: Do my staff need to move anything beforehand?
a: Every hamlet and every concession between, at the same flat pricing as Main Street. The routes pass daily; no address waits longer or pays more.

items.q: Is one desk or a single copier too small to book?
a: With patience across every building. Keepsakes and documents get set aside wherever they surface, meaningful finds go to the family rather than a bin, and equipment or scrap sorts for proper recycling. Executors get updates and documentation without needing to make the drive.
